run_xnli_training_evaluation: run XNLI training and evaluation across all supported languages for cross-lingual NLI classification
train_xnli_model: train the XNLI model by finetuning the embedder and projection layer on the English training set
eval_xnli_accuracy: evaluate the XNLI model accuracy on validation and test sets across all 15 supported languages
load_xnli_data: load XNLI cross-lingual classification data with binarized sentences and labels for all splits and languages
get_xnli_iterator: get a monolingual data iterator for a specific split and language with optional shuffling and size grouping
